# pipellm-pi-provider

> PipeLLM provider for Pi: gateway setup, macOS Keychain login and an Incur management CLI.

- [README](README.md): installation, slash commands, CLI, compatibility and releases.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): source changes and required checks.
- [Contract](SPEC.md): runtime, credential, distribution and acceptance rules.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): review boundaries and private vulnerability reports.
- [CLI guide](SKILL.md): safe command discovery, previews and credential operations.
- [Extension](src/index.ts): native provider registration and optional tool observer.
- [CLI](src/cli.ts): configuration, authentication and diagnostics.
- [Build](scripts/build.ts): compiled payload, source, licenses and installers.
- [Tests](tests/): offline contracts, golden fixtures and opt-in live checks.
- [Pi custom providers](https://pi.dev/docs/latest/custom-provider)
- [Pi extensions](https://pi.dev/docs/latest/extensions)
- [Pi packages](https://pi.dev/docs/latest/packages)
